text:
elaine (Comms): Quick postmortem follow-up: we need a locked customer comms cadence and an owner for redaction + consent flow. Also want a field in the postmortem for recurring-pattern checks.

sam (SRE): I can take the redaction checklist. Will include concrete rules for logs, hostnames, secrets, and request/response redaction.

toni (Customer Success): Timeline ask: short statuspage blurb ASAP, a 72h customer summary with a 3-line "for your customers" snippet, and an ETA for the public RCA. CS needs paste-ready copy.

marta (Legal): 72h summary is OK. Any RCA that contains customer-identifying info or contractual detail needs legal review before external release. I'll draft a consent/sign-off flow.

task-bot: Reminder: create action in incidents tracker with 72h due for initial customer summary.

elaine (Comms): Proposed short status copy: "We experienced elevated errors affecting <service>. Mitigation applied; service returned to normal at <end>. A follow-up summary will be published within 72 hours." 72h summary outline: impact, mitigation, what were doing next (owner + ETA), CS-ready blurb, support link.

sam (SRE): Checklist highlights: remove PII/keys, mask customer hostnames to GENERIC_HOST_n, redact request/response bodies containing identifiers, avoid verbatim stack traces with customer paths. Add a `customer_consent_required` flag.

toni (Customer Success): Consent flag is critical. If we want to include a customer quote or example we need written opt-in with copy approval. CS will coordinate outreach.

marta (Legal): I'll add a sign-off chain: redaction -> legal quick review -> comms final review -> publish. For customer quotes: require written consent with exact quoted text and stamp from legal.

sam (SRE): I'll also add a `recurring-pattern-check` to the postmortem template that queries the past 180 days for similar alerts and sets `recurring=true/false`. If true, include recommended outreach (none / targeted email / account exec reach-out).

toni (Customer Success): If `recurring=true` please include suggested outreach level and suggested CS copy in the 72h summary so teams can act fast. Also include a "severity" tag (partial/major/outage) to prioritize accounts.

elainE (Comms): small edit: typo on my last msg -> will update template with severity and a 3-line CS blurb.

elaine (Comms): Action owners: sam: redaction checklist + recurring query (48h), elaine: status + 72h templates + CS blurb (24h), marta: consent/sign-off doc (72h), toni: CS reuse snippets (3 business days). React with :+1: to accept.

sam (SRE): :+1:

toni (Customer Success): :+1:

marta (Legal): :+1:

task-bot: Action created: INC-8142 (customer-comms-followup)  72h due for 72h summary, 14d for public RCA.

elaine (Comms): I'll file the tracker items and schedule a 20m sync tomorrow to walk through redaction examples and the sign-off flow. Leaving thread open for edge cases (regulated customers, on-prem/private deployments). Tag me and Legal if you hit one.
